rules.statement: All state elements of m_spi_master shall be clocked by the rising edge of i_clk, the only clock of the block.
o_sclk shall be produced as a data output timed by i_clk.
o_sclk shall not clock any state element inside the block.
i_miso shall be treated as synchronous to i_clk and sampled without a synchroniser.
All outputs shall take their reset values at once, without waiting for an edge of i_clk.
o_sclk shall equal the current value of i_cpol and follow every change of i_cpol combinationally.
o_rsp_valid shall be 0 and o_rsp_data shall be 8'h00.

rules.condition: While i_rst_n = 0, whatever the values of i_cmd_valid and o_cmd_ready
rules.statement: The master shall not accept a command.
The transfer in progress shall be aborted.
No response shall be produced for the aborted transfer.

rules.condition: Reset asserted while a shown byte or a held byte exists
rules.statement: That byte shall be discarded without a response handshake.
The master shall be in Idle with the gap requirement met and able to accept a command at the first edge at which i_rst_n is 1.
The minimum o_cs_n high time of REQ-CS-005 shall not be required; after an aborted burst the high time is the reset duration plus time until next acceptance.
